mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print (sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id, sys99_string01, sys99_string02) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId}, org02_kor_nm, org02_level_cd FROM ( select * from ( select * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY org01_code_id ORDER BY org02_mod_date DESC) AS rn from org01_code inner join org02_info on org01_code_id = org02_code_id where org01_company_id = #{companyId} and org02_mod_date < #{baseDate} ) t where rn = 1 and (org01_close_date > #{baseDate} OR org01_close_date IS null) and org02_code_id NOT IN (select org02_parent_code_id from ( select * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY org01_code_id ORDER BY org02_mod_date DESC) AS rn from org01_code inner join org02_info on org01_code_id = org02_code_id where org01_company_id = #{companyId} and org02_mod_date < #{baseDate} ) t where rn = 1 group by org02_parent_code_id) and org02_level_cd NOT IN (SELECT sys09_code FROM sys09_code c , sys08_code_kind k , sys13_code_group g WHERE sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id AND sys08_code_kind_id = sys13_code_kind_id AND sys09_code_id = sys13_code_id AND sys13_kind_group_cd = 'OrgLevelCode001' AND f_trunc(#{baseDate, jdbcType=DATE}) <= ( CASE WHEN sys09_close_date IS NULL THEN f_trunc(#{baseDate, jdbcType=DATE}) ELSE f_trunc(sys09_close_date) END ) AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT max(x.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code x WHERE x.sys09_code_kind_id = c.sys09_code_kind_id AND x.sys09_company_id = c.sys09_company_id AND x.sys09_code = c.sys09_code AND x.sys09_apply_date <= f_trunc(#{baseDate, jdbcType=DATE}) ) ORDER BY sys09_seq ) ) o
